title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono attend peace rally in New York City | 1972
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono attended a peace rally in New York City on 22 April 1972.

The National Peace Action Coalition Rally began at 76th Street and Central Park West in Manhattan, passed down 59th, to 42nd via 7th Avenue, and then down 42nd to Bryant Park. Around 30,000 people attended the rally, part of a nationwide day of protests and demonstrations against US involvement in the Vietnam War.

A platform was erected at 40th and 6th, from where Lennon and Ono led the crowd through a version of ‘Give Peace A Chance’.
